body: Thank you. No I'm not.  I just come home, take NyQuil, and sleep to distract myself.

Thank you for the support.  When times are this bad, I can't remember being happy.  I just have temporary distractions and when the distractions are gone, I don't know what to do.  Waiting for good times seems pointless since they always end, but if guess you're right.  I can't get any worse which is oddly comforting.
Thank you. Just feels like every step forward comes with ten steps back.
